note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor after the userns conversion. The unit's only change since the last verdict is userns.Enter(t) as its first statement (the child re-runs the whole body in its own user, network and mount namespace; a child failure or skip propagates to the parent, and a child that ran nothing fails it) plus removal of EPERM/EACCES skips, so a refused privilege now fails instead of skipping. Assertions are byte-identical. Section 6.1: 'This specification mandates setting and verifying TTL=255 of those as well as the main protocol packets.' Setting: TestGTSMTransmittedICMPErrorCarriesTTL255 (packet[8]==255) and its ICMPv6 twin (packet[7]==255) over the route installGTSMRoute installs and reads back; the withdraw negatives require the system default and not 255, binding the 255 to Ze's route. Verifying IPv4: TestGTSMDropsADangerousQuotedICMPError waits on the quoted-destination term counter, then fails if IcmpMsg InType3 rose, if any other term matched, or if TCPMinTTLDrop moved, from the peer and from a third host; TestGTSMDeliversAQuotedICMPErrorAtTTL255 is the negative, same message at TTL 255 must raise InType3 by one and match no term. Verifying IPv6: TestGTSMMinHopCountDropsALowHopLimitICMPv6Error requires TCPMinTTLDrop +1 and no socket error; TestGTSMWithoutMinHopCountDeliversTheSameICMPv6Error requires no drop and ECONNREFUSED delivered.
